content_of_post_to_answer: What is something that changed your personality forever?
answer: The biggest change in my personality came from realizing that being liked and being respected are not the same thing. I spent years adjusting myself to avoid disappointing people, until I noticed that constant approval-seeking quietly removes your own voice. The change was not becoming colder; it was learning that honesty may cost some connections, but pretending costs your relationship with yourself.
